questions.why: Velocity is speed in a given direction, so it has magnitude and direction.

questions.q: A car accelerates uniformly from rest to 24 m/s in 8.0 s. What is its acceleration?
A section of a speed–time graph is a horizontal straight line above the time axis. What is the object doing?
questions.why: Speed is not changing, so the speed is constant (it would only be at rest on a distance–time graph).

questions.q: A cyclist accelerates uniformly from rest to 12 m/s in 5.0 s. Calculate the distance travelled in this time.
questions.model: distance = area under speed–time graph = ½ × 12 × 5.0 = 30 m
